data.title: 长离 · 今州红绸的花嫁授课
data.description: 【今州山庭·清晨】长离穿着红白层叠婚纱站在山庭长廊，手中捧着凤凰羽毛与白花；她先向镜头伸出手示范一段礼仪步伐，再在花瓣落下时笑着收势，像把耐心也变成了誓约。
data.action: 山庭长廊示范一段礼仪步伐，花瓣落下时收势微笑
data.lighting: clear morning light on red railings
data.mood: 老师把耐心教成花嫁誓约
data.promptProse: Changli from Wuthering Waves wears a layered white-and-red bridal gown with phoenix embroidery, a light veil and a white flower fan. She steps along the mountain veranda with a flower fan and a phoenix feather tucked beside the bouquet. She demonstrates one precise ceremonial turn toward the viewer, then relaxes into a patient smile as red petals drift through the lesson. clear morning light on red railings.
